verdict.rationale: An open-source license is a fair question for a government web portal, since agencies can publish their portal code. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a source repository, a code release, or an open license. The probes found only a reachable public Business Center page, no API and no llms.txt, so the axis applies and is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
